summary: Exclude undeclared agent recipients from native mail delivery coverage instead of treating them as unknown

replay.detail: Existing retained mail facts are reduced with the new recipient exclusion rule.

schema.detail: No schema or claim kind changes.

rules.detail: Agent recipients without a declared host count as excluded, with excluded_undeclared_recipient diagnostics. Owned recipients with missing frontiers and all other uncertain evidence remain unknown.

compatibility.detail: Reuses the existing excluded lifecycle sample and row accounting.
